issues.title: Missing: Content-Security-Policy
issues.description: No CSP header. XSS attacks are not mitigated by the browser.
issues.nginx_fix: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self';" always;
issues.apache_fix: Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'"

issues.title: Missing: X-Frame-Options
issues.description: No X-Frame-Options. Site can be embedded in iframes (clickjacking risk).

issues.title: Missing: X-Content-Type-Options
issues.description: No X-Content-Type-Options. Browser may MIME-sniff responses into executable content.
